title: يبدو من الصوت / الكلام أن
form: It sounds like + noun or clause

cells.en: It sounds like rain outside.
cells.ar: يبدو أن المطر يتساقط في الخارج من صوته.
cells.description: Adult listening to rain beyond a window

cells.en: It sounds like a great idea.
cells.ar: تبدو فكرة رائعة من وصفك لها.
cells.description: Adult responding positively to a spoken proposal

cells.en: It sounds like someone is at the door.
cells.ar: يبدو أن هناك شخصًا عند الباب من الصوت.
cells.description: Adult hearing a knock at the door

cells.en: It sounds like the children are having fun.
cells.ar: يبدو أن الأطفال يستمتعون من أصواتهم.
cells.description: Adult listening to children’s cheerful play through a doorway

cells.en: It sounds like the washing machine has stopped.
cells.ar: يبدو من الصوت أن الغسالة توقفت.
cells.description: Adult listening near a suddenly quiet laundry room

cells.en: It sounds like you had a busy day.
cells.ar: يبدو من كلامك أنك مررت بيوم حافل.
cells.description: Friend listening as another adult describes a busy day

cells.en: It sounds like a useful workshop.
cells.ar: تبدو ورشة مفيدة من وصفك لها.
cells.description: Adult listening with interest to a workshop description

cells.en: It sounds like someone is moving furniture upstairs.
cells.ar: يبدو من الصوت أن أحدًا يحرك الأثاث في الطابق العلوي.
cells.description: Adult listening toward the ceiling after hearing furniture move

cells.en: It sounds like the bus is approaching.
cells.ar: يبدو من الصوت أن الحافلة تقترب.
cells.description: Passenger listening toward an approaching bus outside the frame

cells.en: It sounds like we need a different plan.
cells.ar: يبدو من كلامك أننا نحتاج إلى خطة مختلفة.
cells.description: Colleagues reconsidering a plan after hearing a new problem

cells.en: It sounds like a bird, but I can't see it.
cells.ar: يبدو الصوت صوت طائر، لكنني لا أراه.
cells.description: Adult listening for a bird hidden among trees

cells.en: It sounds like she was disappointed with the result.
cells.ar: يبدو من كلامها أنها شعرت بخيبة أمل من النتيجة.
cells.description: Adult listening sympathetically to a friend's account of a result

title: عذرًا / لو سمحت
form: Excuse me + request or polite interruption

cells.en: Excuse me, is this seat free?
cells.ar: عذرًا، هل هذا المقعد شاغر؟
cells.description: Traveler indicating an empty bus seat

cells.en: Excuse me, where is the library?
cells.ar: عذرًا، أين المكتبة؟
cells.description: Visitor asking a librarian for directions

cells.en: Excuse me, can I pass through?
cells.ar: عذرًا، هل يمكنني المرور؟
cells.description: Passenger politely passing through an aisle

cells.en: Excuse me, may I ask a question?
cells.ar: عذرًا، هل يمكنني طرح سؤال؟
cells.description: Adult learner raising a hand

cells.en: Excuse me, could you point me toward the exit?
cells.ar: عذرًا، هل يمكنك أن تدلني على المخرج؟
cells.description: Visitor asking a museum attendant for the exit

cells.en: Excuse me, I think you dropped your ticket.
cells.ar: عذرًا، أظن أنك أسقطت تذكرتك.
cells.description: Passenger returning a dropped ticket

cells.en: Excuse me, does this train stop at the airport?
cells.ar: عذرًا، هل يتوقف هذا القطار في المطار؟
cells.description: Traveler asking a railway employee

cells.en: Excuse me, could we have the bill, please?
cells.ar: عذرًا، هل يمكن أن نحصل على الفاتورة من فضلك؟
cells.description: Diners politely attracting a server's attention

cells.en: Excuse me, is anyone using this chair?
cells.ar: عذرًا، هل يستخدم أحد هذا الكرسي؟
cells.description: Adult indicating a spare cafe chair

cells.en: Excuse me, may I add one thing?
cells.ar: عذرًا، هل لي أن أضيف أمرًا واحدًا؟
cells.description: Colleague politely joining a meeting discussion

cells.en: Excuse me, your bag is blocking the doorway.
cells.ar: عذرًا، حقيبتك تسد المدخل.
cells.description: Visitor indicating luggage beside a doorway

cells.en: Excuse me, could you help me find the rice?
cells.ar: عذرًا، هل يمكنك مساعدتي في العثور على الأرز؟
cells.description: Shopper asking an employee in a grocery aisle

cells.en: Could you please speak a little slower?
cells.ar: هل يمكنك التحدث ببطء أكثر قليلًا من فضلك؟
cells.description: Learner asking a speaker to slow down

cells.en: Could you please close the window?
cells.ar: هل يمكنك إغلاق النافذة من فضلك؟
cells.description: Person indicating an open window

cells.en: Could you please send me the address?
cells.ar: هل يمكنك إرسال العنوان إلي من فضلك؟
cells.description: Traveler asking for an address

cells.en: Could you please repeat the last sentence?
cells.ar: هل يمكنك إعادة الجملة الأخيرة من فضلك؟
cells.description: Learner requesting repetition at a table

cells.en: Could you please hold the door for a moment?
cells.ar: هل يمكنك إبقاء الباب مفتوحًا لحظة من فضلك؟
cells.description: Adult holding a door for someone carrying boxes

cells.en: Could you please show me where to sign?
cells.ar: هل يمكنك أن تريني أين أوقّع من فضلك؟
cells.description: Clerk indicating a signature line on a form

cells.en: Could you please turn down the television?
cells.ar: هل يمكنك خفض صوت التلفاز من فضلك؟
cells.description: Two adults beside a television in a living room

cells.en: Could you please bring two more chairs?
cells.ar: هل يمكنك إحضار كرسيين إضافيين من فضلك؟
cells.description: Host asking for extra chairs at a gathering

cells.en: Could you please explain the second step?
cells.ar: هل يمكنك شرح الخطوة الثانية من فضلك؟
cells.description: Teacher demonstrating a practical task

cells.en: Could you please move your bicycle away from the gate?
cells.ar: هل يمكنك إبعاد دراجتك عن البوابة من فضلك؟
cells.description: Neighbors beside a bicycle blocking a gate

cells.en: Could you please email me the receipt?
cells.ar: هل يمكنك إرسال الإيصال إلي بالبريد الإلكتروني من فضلك؟
cells.description: Customer speaking with a shop cashier

cells.en: Could you please wait until everyone is seated?
cells.ar: هل يمكنك الانتظار حتى يجلس الجميع من فضلك؟
cells.description: Meeting organizer addressing a presenter

title: هل تمانع أن
form: Would you mind + verb ending in ing

cells.en: Would you mind moving your bag?
cells.ar: هل تمانع نقل حقيبتك؟
cells.description: Passenger indicating a bag on a seat

cells.en: Would you mind lowering the music?
cells.ar: هل تمانع خفض صوت الموسيقى؟
cells.description: Neighbor requesting quieter music

cells.en: Would you mind waiting a moment?
cells.ar: هل تمانع الانتظار لحظة؟
cells.description: Customer asking someone to wait

cells.en: Would you mind checking this sentence?
cells.ar: هل تمانع مراجعة هذه الجملة؟
cells.description: Tutor checking an adult learner's sentence

cells.en: Would you mind taking a photo of us?
cells.ar: هل تمانع التقاط صورة لنا؟
cells.description: Couple handing a camera to another adult Use respectful conversational distance and neutral gestures, no romantic staging or physical intimacy.

cells.en: Would you mind carrying this box upstairs?
cells.ar: هل تمانع حمل هذا الصندوق إلى الطابق العلوي؟
cells.description: Adults beside a box and a staircase

cells.en: Would you mind speaking a little more clearly?
cells.ar: هل تمانع التحدث بوضوح أكثر قليلًا؟
cells.description: Learner politely asking a speaker for clearer speech

cells.en: Would you mind keeping the gate closed?
cells.ar: هل تمانع إبقاء البوابة مغلقة؟
cells.description: Neighbors beside a garden gate

cells.en: Would you mind watching my suitcase for a minute?
cells.ar: هل تمانع مراقبة حقيبتي لدقيقة؟
cells.description: Travelers waiting beside luggage

cells.en: Would you mind writing your name here?
cells.ar: هل تمانع كتابة اسمك هنا؟
cells.description: Receptionist indicating a blank form

cells.en: Would you mind helping me set the table?
cells.ar: هل تمانع مساعدتي في تجهيز المائدة؟
cells.description: Family members arranging plates

cells.en: Would you mind sending the file again?
cells.ar: هل تمانع إرسال الملف مجددًا؟
cells.description: Colleagues checking a laptop attachment

title: هل تمانع إذا أنا
form: Do you mind if I + present verb

cells.en: Do you mind if I sit here?
cells.ar: هل تمانع إن جلست هنا؟
cells.description: Traveler asking to use a seat

cells.en: Do you mind if I open the window?
cells.ar: هل تمانع إن فتحت النافذة؟
cells.description: Person requesting permission to open a window

cells.en: Do you mind if I use your pen?
cells.ar: هل تمانع إن استخدمت قلمك؟
cells.description: Learner asking to borrow a pen

cells.en: Do you mind if I join the discussion?
cells.ar: هل تمانع إن شاركت في النقاش؟
cells.description: Adult joining a discussion circle

cells.en: Do you mind if I charge my phone here?
cells.ar: هل تمانع إن شحنت هاتفي هنا؟
cells.description: Visitor indicating an electrical outlet

cells.en: Do you mind if I take a few notes?
cells.ar: هل تمانع إن دوّنت بعض الملاحظات؟
cells.description: Adult learner opening a notebook during a conversation

cells.en: Do you mind if I bring my brother?
cells.ar: هل تمانع إن أحضرت أخي؟
cells.description: Adult discussing a dinner invitation by phone

cells.en: Do you mind if I turn on the fan?
cells.ar: هل تمانع إن شغلت المروحة؟
cells.description: Two adults in a warm room beside a fan

cells.en: Do you mind if I ask about the price?
cells.ar: هل تمانع إن سألت عن السعر؟
cells.description: Customer speaking politely with a craft seller

cells.en: Do you mind if I leave my coat here?
cells.ar: هل تمانع إن تركت معطفي هنا؟
cells.description: Guest holding a coat beside a chair

cells.en: Do you mind if I record our lesson?
cells.ar: هل تمانع إن سجلت درسنا؟
cells.description: Learner asking a tutor before using a recorder

cells.en: Do you mind if I try a different approach?
cells.ar: هل تمانع إن جربت طريقة مختلفة؟
cells.description: Colleagues considering a practical problem

cells.en: May I come in, please?
cells.ar: هل تسمح لي بالدخول من فضلك؟
cells.description: Learner waiting at a classroom doorway

cells.en: May I use this computer?
cells.ar: هل يمكنني استخدام هذا الحاسوب؟
cells.description: Visitor requesting a computer

cells.en: May I take a photo here?
cells.ar: هل تسمح لي بالتقاط صورة هنا؟
cells.description: Tourist asking before taking a picture

cells.en: May I leave a little early today?
cells.ar: هل يمكنني المغادرة مبكرًا قليلًا اليوم؟
cells.description: Employee discussing an early departure

cells.en: May I see the menu, please?
cells.ar: هل لي أن أرى قائمة الطعام من فضلك؟
cells.description: Diner requesting a menu from a server

cells.en: May I ask who is in charge?
cells.ar: هل لي أن أسأل من المسؤول؟
cells.description: Visitor speaking with a reception clerk

cells.en: May I take this chair?
cells.ar: هل يمكنني أخذ هذا الكرسي؟
cells.description: Guest indicating a spare chair

cells.en: May I have a glass of water?
cells.ar: هل لي بكأس ماء؟
cells.description: Adult asking a host for water

cells.en: May I speak to the manager?
cells.ar: هل يمكنني التحدث إلى المدير؟
cells.description: Customer at a service desk

cells.en: May I park my bicycle here?
cells.ar: هل يمكنني إيقاف دراجتي هنا؟
cells.description: Cyclist speaking with a building attendant

cells.en: May I keep this copy?
cells.ar: هل يمكنني الاحتفاظ بهذه النسخة؟
cells.description: Learner holding a worksheet beside a teacher

cells.en: May I make one suggestion?
cells.ar: هل لي أن أقدم اقتراحًا واحدًا؟
cells.description: Colleague politely raising a hand at a meeting

cells.en: I'd love to join the trip.
cells.ar: يسعدني الانضمام إلى الرحلة.
cells.description: Adult enthusiastically accepting a trip invitation

cells.en: I'd love to meet your family.
cells.ar: يسعدني التعرف إلى عائلتك.
cells.description: Guest greeting a friend's family

cells.en: I'd love to learn that recipe.
cells.ar: يسعدني تعلم تلك الوصفة.
cells.description: Cook learning a recipe from a friend

cells.en: I'd love to help with the project.
cells.ar: يسعدني المساعدة في المشروع.
cells.description: Colleagues accepting a project task

cells.en: I'd love to hear about your journey.
cells.ar: يسعدني أن أسمع عن رحلتك.
cells.description: Friends talking over travel photographs

cells.en: I'd love to spend the afternoon at the beach.
cells.ar: أود كثيرًا قضاء فترة بعد الظهر على الشاطئ.
cells.description: Adult happily considering a beach outing Stage the entire scene fully clothed on dry land; empty water, no swimmers, sunbathers or revealing background figures.

cells.en: I'd love to try your homemade bread.
cells.ar: يسعدني تذوق خبزك المنزلي.
cells.description: Host offering freshly baked bread

cells.en: I'd love to volunteer at the library.
cells.ar: يسعدني التطوع في المكتبة.
cells.description: Adult offering to help a librarian sort books

cells.en: I'd love to show you around our town.
cells.ar: يسعدني أن أصحبك في جولة ببلدتنا.
cells.description: Resident welcoming a visitor in a town square

cells.en: I'd love to sing with the group.
cells.ar: يسعدني الغناء مع المجموعة.
cells.description: Adult joining a community singing rehearsal

cells.en: I'd love to visit the exhibition this weekend.
cells.ar: أود كثيرًا زيارة المعرض في نهاية الأسبوع.
cells.description: Friends planning an art gallery visit

cells.en: I'd love to join you, but I have to work tonight.
cells.ar: يسعدني الانضمام إليكم، لكن عليّ العمل الليلة.
cells.description: Adult politely declining an invitation beside work materials

title: أخشى أنني لا أستطيع
form: I'm afraid I can't + base verb

cells.en: I'm afraid I can't come on Friday.
cells.ar: أخشى أنني لا أستطيع الحضور يوم الجمعة.
cells.description: Adult apologizing for declining a Friday invitation

cells.en: I'm afraid I can't stay very long.
cells.ar: أخشى أنني لا أستطيع البقاء طويلًا.
cells.description: Guest checking a watch before leaving

cells.en: I'm afraid I can't answer that question yet.
cells.ar: أخشى أنني لا أستطيع الإجابة عن ذلك السؤال بعد.
cells.description: Teacher unable to answer a question yet

cells.en: I'm afraid I can't help this afternoon.
cells.ar: أخشى أنني لا أستطيع المساعدة بعد الظهر.
cells.description: Colleague explaining an unavailable afternoon

cells.en: I'm afraid I can't lend you my car today.
cells.ar: أخشى أنني لا أستطيع إقراضك سيارتي اليوم.
cells.description: Adult explaining car keys are needed for work

cells.en: I'm afraid I can't hear you very well.
cells.ar: أخشى أنني لا أسمعك جيدًا.
cells.description: Adult holding a phone in a noisy station

cells.en: I'm afraid I can't accept this invitation.
cells.ar: أخشى أنني لا أستطيع قبول هذه الدعوة.
cells.description: Adult politely responding to an invitation

cells.en: I'm afraid I can't finish before noon.
cells.ar: أخشى أنني لا أستطيع الانتهاء قبل الظهر.
cells.description: Worker discussing unfinished papers beside a clock

cells.en: I'm afraid I can't offer you a discount.
cells.ar: أخشى أنني لا أستطيع تقديم خصم لك.
cells.description: Shopkeeper speaking politely to a customer

cells.en: I'm afraid I can't join the call from the train.
cells.ar: أخشى أنني لا أستطيع الانضمام إلى المكالمة من القطار.
cells.description: Traveler holding a phone on a moving train

cells.en: I'm afraid I can't repair it without the right part.
cells.ar: أخشى أنني لا أستطيع إصلاحه دون القطعة المناسبة.
cells.description: Technician showing a missing part to a customer

cells.en: I'm afraid I can't attend today, but I can come tomorrow.
cells.ar: أخشى أنني لا أستطيع الحضور اليوم، لكن يمكنني المجيء غدًا.
cells.description: Adult suggesting another appointment on a calendar

title: ما رأيك في
form: How about + noun or verb ending in ing

cells.en: How about having tea after class?
cells.ar: ما رأيك في تناول الشاي بعد الحصة؟
cells.description: Friends sharing tea after a class

cells.en: How about meeting at the library?
cells.ar: ما رأيك في اللقاء في المكتبة؟
cells.description: Learners arranging a library meeting

cells.en: How about a different color?
cells.ar: ما رأيك في لون مختلف؟
cells.description: Shopper considering another color

cells.en: How about taking the earlier bus?
cells.ar: ما رأيك في ركوب الحافلة الأسبق؟
cells.description: Travelers considering an earlier bus

cells.en: How about a picnic by the river?
cells.ar: ما رأيك في نزهة لتناول الطعام بجانب النهر؟
cells.description: Friends considering a riverside picnic

cells.en: How about asking the teacher for another example?
cells.ar: ما رأيك في طلب مثال آخر من المعلم؟
cells.description: Adult learners discussing a difficult exercise

cells.en: How about cooking together tonight?
cells.ar: ما رأيك في أن نطبخ معًا الليلة؟
cells.description: Friends preparing vegetables in a kitchen

cells.en: How about using a larger box?
cells.ar: ما رأيك في استخدام صندوق أكبر؟
cells.description: Adults packing books into a small box

cells.en: How about inviting our neighbors?
cells.ar: ما رأيك في دعوة جيراننا؟
cells.description: Family planning a friendly gathering

cells.en: How about a short walk before dinner?
cells.ar: ما رأيك في نزهة قصيرة قبل العشاء؟
cells.description: Couple putting on walking shoes before dinner Use respectful conversational distance and neutral gestures, no romantic staging or physical intimacy.

cells.en: How about trying the exercise without looking?
cells.ar: ما رأيك في تجربة التمرين دون النظر؟
cells.description: Learners closing a textbook before practice

cells.en: How about meeting online if it rains?
cells.ar: ما رأيك في أن نلتقي عبر الإنترنت إذا أمطرت؟
cells.description: Friends planning a video call during wet weather

title: شكرًا لك على
form: Thank you for + noun or verb ending in ing

cells.en: Thank you for waiting for me.
cells.ar: شكرًا على انتظاري.
cells.description: Friend patiently waiting for another adult

cells.en: Thank you for your kind message.
cells.ar: شكرًا على رسالتك اللطيفة.
cells.description: Adult reading a kind message

cells.en: Thank you for helping our team.
cells.ar: شكرًا على مساعدة فريقنا.
cells.description: Team members thanking a helpful colleague

cells.en: Thank you for explaining the answer.
cells.ar: شكرًا على شرح الإجابة.
cells.description: Learner thanking a tutor after an explanation

cells.en: Thank you for showing me the way.
cells.ar: شكرًا لإرشادي إلى الطريق.
cells.description: Visitor thanking a resident after receiving directions

cells.en: Thank you for the delicious meal.
cells.ar: شكرًا على الوجبة اللذيذة.
cells.description: Guest thanking a host at the dinner table

cells.en: Thank you for bringing the missing documents.
cells.ar: شكرًا لإحضار المستندات الناقصة.

cells.en: Thank you for looking after my plants.
cells.ar: شكرًا لاعتنائك بنباتاتي.

cells.en: Thank you for listening so carefully.
cells.ar: شكرًا لإصغائك باهتمام بالغ.

cells.en: Thank you for inviting my family.
cells.ar: شكرًا لدعوة عائلتي.
cells.description: Family arriving at a friendly gathering

cells.en: Thank you for giving us extra time.
cells.ar: شكرًا لمنحنا وقتًا إضافيًا.
cells.description: Learners thanking a teacher beside their project

cells.en: Thank you for keeping your promise.
cells.ar: شكرًا لوفائك بوعدك.
cells.description: Friends greeting after a promised act of help
